Name: Cat King Portrait(dead boy detectives)
Author: Tampey
Description:
This portrait is a The Cat King from Dead Boy detectives.

Originally, the cat king has full-length hair, but I made it according to my taste.

Please make the value of cat king - black in the config of dead boy detective.

[b][ !!! Please read it !!! ][/b]
I made this based on Black, only the characters I made, and the cat included in the portrait is an AI image.

[u]These download files don't have a manifast.json file. You have to find and add the path file yourself.[/u]


How to install

[list]
[*]If you don't already have them, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod 
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits and create a new folder.
[*]Put the portraits from this mod into the new folder.
[/list]
Can use both Portraiture and PortraiturePlus . I usually use Portraiture, and I can't explain this because I don't use Portraitureplus (Because I don't know how to it)

You don't need to rename this file. Just put it in the name I made and it works.
